name: Kublai Khan
role: Emperor of Yuan China from 1271 to 1294
contribution: The founder and first emperor of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty of China.

checks.lead: Kublai Khan (23 September 1215 – 18 February 1294), also known by his temple name as the Emperor Shizu of Yuan and his regnal name Setsen Khan, was the founder and first emperor of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty of China. He proclaimed the dynastic name "Great Yuan" in 1271, and ruled Yuan China until his death in 1294.
